extensionName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store, chrome://extensions, and the extensions menu. Product name: keep it identical in every locale. Chrome allows at most 45 characters.

extensionShortName.description: Short name used where Chrome has no room for the full name, such as under the toolbar icon. Product name: keep it identical in every locale. Chrome allows at most 12 characters.

extensionDescription.message: View, copy, format, and export YouTube transcripts in Chrome's Side Panel. No account, ads, tracking, or transcript server.
extensionDescription.description: Store summary and the description under chrome://extensions. Chrome allows at most 132 characters, so keep every locale within that limit. Must describe the same features as every other locale.

actionTitle.description: Tooltip on the toolbar icon. Clicking the icon opens the Side Panel.
